risks: Non-string inputs such as None, 1 or a list must raise ValueError. validate_priority covers this, but an unhashable value must not raise TypeError first.
Priority validation must run before iterating, so an invalid value raises ValueError even when the store is empty.
Task.priority is mutable and unvalidated. A task whose priority was edited directly to an invalid value should simply not match, and it must not raise an error.
The method must filter on self._tasks.values(), which is in insertion order. Restored stores can have non-ascending IDs, so sorting by ID would break creation order (AC-3).
The method must return a new list of the same live Task objects, not copies. It must not mutate the store or filter by completion state.
